chunks: So no ransom will be accepted of you on this day, or of those who refused to believe. Hell will be your refuge and the only friend -- and how evil a destination!
ai.seo_question: What happens to the ransom on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Hadid?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the finality of divine recompense, noting that the ransom (fidya) accepted in battle or for captives becomes void when death or judgment arrives. It highlights that for the disbelievers, Hell serves not merely as a destination but as their 'master' (mawlā), reflecting the concept of divine ownership and ultimate control, while serving as a stern warning against worldly attachments.
